brief:
British police arrested at least 139 Palestine Action supporters on Saturday during protests in London and Edinburgh, according to Al-Monitor. The arrests occurred days before the group's Supreme Court hearing challenging the government's ban on the organization.

Palestine Action has faced restrictions after the Home Office designated it as a banned organization. The group's legal challenge to overturn the ban is set to proceed in the courts.
dek: British police on Saturday arrested at least 139 Palestine Action supporters, who protested in London and Edinburgh days ahead of a court appeal over the government's contentious ban of the group.
title: UK police arrest 139 Palestine Action supporters before court appeal
